image_description: A group of people, including children and adults, are dancing around a tall wooden maypole in an urban park setting. The pole is topped with a decorative crown-like structure from which numerous colorful ribbons (red, blue, yellow, green, pink) extend downwards. The dancers are holding these ribbons and appear to be weaving patterns. The background features city buildings and trees.
